facts.title: Home | Supermouse.js
facts.description: A modular, high-performance cursor engine for building dynamic, beautiful cursors for the web.

research.name: supermouse.js
research.note: Plugin-based custom cursor engine with spring smoothing, where dot, ring, trail, magnetic and stick effects are separate packages.

effects: Kernel plus plugin cursor architecture with priority-scheduled logic and visual plugins
Magnetic and stick cursor plugins that pull the cursor toward hovered targets

unverified: The source is public at https://github.com/Whitestar14/supermouse-js (MIT, 2 stars); the candidate should be researched as that repository instead of the site.
The magnetic and stick effects are taken from the package list and changelog; only the custom pointer cursor was seen running on the homepage.
